trans-unit.source:
Aspire gives AI coding agents deep observability into your app using the same information visible in the dashboard. Agents use telemetry to diagnose issues faster and verify fixes with confidence. 🚀
- 📦 Resource state, health checks, and relationships - 🖥️ Console logs - 📊 Distributed traces - 🪵 Structured logs
## Getting started
AI agents access dashboard telemetry through the Aspire CLI. If you haven't installed it yet, [install the Aspire CLI]({1}).
Initialize AI agent support in your project with:
```bash aspire agent init ```
This command configures skill files for your AI agent. The skill files tell the agent how to use Aspire CLI commands like [`aspire logs`](https://aspire.dev/reference/cli/commands/aspire-logs/) and [`aspire otel traces`](https://aspire.dev/reference/cli/commands/aspire-otel-traces/).
Once connected, agents can start your app, check resource health, fetch logs and traces, and more.
For more information about using AI agents with Aspire, such as setting up skills, see [AI coding agents]({0}).
trans-unit.target:
Aspire 使用仪表板中显示的相同信息，为 AI 编码智能体提供应用的深度可观测性。智能体利用遥测数据更快地诊断问题，并有把握地验证修复结果。🚀
- 📦 资源状态、运行状况检查和关系 - 🖥️ 控制台日志 - 📊 分布式跟踪 - 🪵 结构化日志
## 开始使用
AI 智能体通过 Aspire CLI 访问仪表板遥测。如果你尚未安装，请[安装 Aspire CLI]({1})。
使用以下命令在项目中初始化 AI 智能体支持:
```bash aspire agent init ```
此命令会为 AI 智能体配置技能文件。技能文件会告诉智能体如何使用 Aspire CLI 命令，例如 [`aspire logs`](https://aspire.dev/reference/cli/commands/aspire-logs/) 和 [`aspire otel traces`](https://aspire.dev/reference/cli/commands/aspire-otel-traces/)。
连接后，智能体就可以启动应用、检查资源运行状况、获取日志和跟踪信息等。
有关如何将 AI 智能体与 Aspire 配合使用的详细信息(例如如何设置技能)，请参阅 [AI 编码智能体]({0})。
trans-unit.note: {0} is the learn more URL, {1} is the install CLI URL

trans-unit.source:
Aspire gives AI coding agents deep observability into your app using the same information visible in the dashboard. Agents use telemetry to diagnose issues faster and verify fixes with confidence. 🚀
- 📊 Distributed traces - 🔗 Trace spans - 🪵 Structured logs - 🗂️ Zip file export
AI agents access dashboard telemetry using the Aspire CLI. [Install the Aspire CLI]({2}) if you haven't already.
Use Aspire CLI commands to retrieve telemetry data directly in your terminal:
```bash aspire otel logs --dashboard-url {0} ```
This is one example of how AI agents can access telemetry for your app. See [`aspire otel`](https://aspire.dev/reference/cli/commands/aspire-otel/) and [`aspire export`](https://aspire.dev/reference/cli/commands/aspire-export/).
For more information about using AI agents with the dashboard, including setting up skills, see [Standalone dashboard and AI coding agents]({1}).
trans-unit.target:
Aspire 使用仪表板中显示的相同信息，为 AI 编码智能体提供应用的深度可观测性。智能体利用遥测数据更快地诊断问题，并有把握地验证修复结果。🚀
- 📊 分布式跟踪 - 🔗 跟踪跨度 - 🪵 结构化日志 - 🗂️ ZIP 文件导出
AI 智能体通过 Aspire CLI 访问仪表板遥测。如果你尚未安装，请[安装 Aspire CLI]({2})。
使用 Aspire CLI 命令直接在终端中检索遥测数据:
```bash aspire otel logs --dashboard-url {0} ```
这是 AI 智能体访问应用遥测方式的一个例子。请参阅 [`aspire otel`](https://aspire.dev/reference/cli/commands/aspire-otel/) 和 [`aspire export`](https://aspire.dev/reference/cli/commands/aspire-export/)。
有关如何将 AI 智能体与仪表板结合使用的更多信息，包括如何设置技能，请参阅[独立仪表板和 AI 编码智能体]({1})。
trans-unit.note: {0} is the dashboard URL, {1} is the learn more URL, {2} is the install CLI URL
